market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: India Industrial Sensors & Transmitters Market: $1.37B (2025) to $2.14B by 2030 (9.37%/yr). India Temperature Sensors Market: $8.3B (2025) to $14.5B by 2032 (7.9%/yr) — this figure is disproportionately larger than the broader industrial sensors/transmitters figure, likely because it includes consumer/automotive temperature sensors well beyond industrial process instrumentation; use cautiously. Global Level and Flow Sensor Market: $27.07B by 2032 (8.73%/yr), North America 34% share (lower-confidence press-release-aggregator source). India Air Pressure Sensor Market: $180-220M (2026), 9-11%/yr through 2035.
market.domesticSlice: Endress+Hauser Flowtec India is ranked #1 flow-meter maker in India per Kompass. KROHNE Marshall Pvt Ltd (Pune JV) posted ~₹203 Cr FY2022 revenue (₹100-500 Cr Tracxn band). Forbes Marshall and Adept Fluidyne are also named as top-5 Indian flow-meter makers.

structureFacts: Jal Jeevan Mission (India's rural piped-water program) is a major structural demand driver — requires level sensors, flow meters, pressure sensors, chlorine analyzers, pump controllers for a 'Digital Wall'/remote command-control monitoring system, with ~$49B cited for the full measurement/monitoring rollout
Government concern about import-dependence (particularly on China) for sensors in this rollout is a real policy tailwind for indigenous manufacturers
NABL/ISO 17025 accreditation and Legal Metrology (OIML-R49) approval act as procurement gatekeepers for government/PHED-type buyers

adoptionStructure.note: Reliability in harsh/hazardous environments (flameproof/explosion-proof ratings), calibration traceability (NABL accreditation), government vendor empanelment (PHED-type approvals), and growing demand for IoT/remote-monitoring capability drive purchasing.
